none.example:
There are 60 seconds in a minute, so 10 minutes is 10 * 60 = 600 seconds.
The fan creates 10 liters per second, so in 600 seconds it creates 10 * 600 = 6000 liters of airflow.
There are 7 days in a week, so in one week the fan creates 6000 * 7 = 42000 liters of airflow.
#### 42000<|endoftext|>
